title: Submarine Propulsion Plant Electrical Manager
raw_text:
Job Title                                                                                                                Job Code
Submarine Propulsion Plant Electrical Manager                                                                            003793
Job Family                               NOC                Short Title (30 Characters)    Short Title (14 Characters)
Management                               TBD                SUB PROPULSION PLANT ELECT MGR SS PPE MGR
Pay Plan             Career Field        Other Relationships and Rules
Enlisted             EMN                 NEC NXXX, 7XXX series and other NECs as assigned
Job Description
Submarine Propulsion Plant Electrical Managers manage operations, maintenance, and training for personnel assigned to electrical divisions and/or
engineering departments; coordinate ship electrical safety programs; perform audits of divisional and/or departmental programs; analyze trends and
implement process improvements; perform risk management; and manage work critical to the movement of Naval tactical and strategic forces.

DoD Relationship                                          O*NET Relationship
Group Title                DoD Code                 Occupation Title                      SOC Code           Job Family
Nuclear Power              166100                   Compliance Managers                   11-9199.02         Management

Skills                                                                      Abilities
Quality Control Analysis                                                    Problem Sensitivity
Systems Analysis                                                            Deductive Reasoning
Management of Personnel Resources                                           Oral Expression
Operation Monitoring                                                        Information Ordering
Reading Comprehension                                                       Near Vision
Coordination                                                                Selective Attention
Operation and Control                                                       Spatial Orientation
Complex Problem Solving                                                     Speed of Closure
Equipment Maintenance                                                       Written Expression
Systems Evaluation                                                          Arm-Hand Steadiness

                                                        CASUALTY CONTROL
Paygrade            Task Type            Task Statements
E6                  CORE                 Direct shutdown watch section casualty operations
E4                  CORE                 Perform corrective actions to combat reactor plant casualties
E6                  CORE                 Supervise casualty electrical distribution operations
E7                  CORE                 Supervise casualty power system operations

                                             ELECTRICAL CONTROL EQUIPMENT
Paygrade            Task Type            Task Statements
E7                  CORE                 Perform close-out inspections of electrical equipment

                                                  ELECTRICAL INSTALLATIONS
Paygrade            Task Type            Task Statements
E5                  CORE                 Install submarine battery cell jumpers

                                                   MOTORS AND GENERATORS
Paygrade            Task Type            Task Statements
E5                  CORE                 Inspect motor generators
E5                  CORE                 Test motor generators
E5                  CORE                 Troubleshoot motor generators




                                                                   EMN-27
                                    POWER DISTRIBUTION
Paygrade   Task Type   Task Statements
E4         CORE        Analyze electric plant trends
E4         CORE        Inspect high voltage systems (i.e., greater than 700 Volts)
E7         CORE        Supervise high voltage electrical safety work (i.e., greater than 700 volts)
E4         CORE        Test high voltage systems (i.e., greater than 700 Volts)
E5         CORE        Troubleshoot high voltage systems (i.e., greater than 700 Volts)

                              REACTOR PLANT EQUIPMENT
Paygrade   Task Type   Task Statements
E4         CORE        Analyze pressure and temperature parameter trends
E5         CORE        Analyze shutdown reactor plant trends
E6         CORE        Control maintenance on systems affecting remote operability
E4         CORE        Inspect reactor compartment
E6         CORE        Verify conditions established for prevention of inadvertent discharges

                              TECHNICAL ADMINISTRATION
Paygrade   Task Type   Task Statements
E5         NON-CORE    Analyze machinery vibration data for validity
E6         CORE        Audit division records (e.g., electrical, mechanical, material history, etc.)
E7         CORE        Audit engineering and reactor department records
E5         CORE        Manage battery program
E7         CORE        Manage equipment modifications (e.g., reactor, non-reactor, Ship Alternation
                       (SHIPALT), etc.)
E6         CORE        Supervise division maintenance operations (e.g., electrical, mechanical, reactor
                       control, etc.)




                                              EMN-28

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
